sq.q: Ordinary electric fan increases the kinetic energy of the air molecules caused by the fan blades pushing them means the air temperature increases slightly rather than cool the air! why use it?
sq.urdu: عام برقی پنکھا ہوا کے سالمات کو دھکیل کر ان کی حرکی توانائی بڑھاتا ہے یعنی ہوا کا درجۂ حرارت تھوڑا بڑھتا ہے نہ کہ گھٹتا! پھر اسے کیوں استعمال کرتے ہیں؟
sq.pashto: عادي برېښنايي پکی هوا مالیکولونه ټېل وهي او حرکي انرژي یې زیاتوي یعنې د هوا تودوخه لږ لوړېږي نه کمېږي! نو ولې یې کاروو؟
sq.ans: The moving air removes the humid layer next to the skin and greatly increases the rate of evaporation of perspiration; evaporation takes latent heat from the body, so we feel cooler even though the air warms very slightly.
sq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

sq.q: Why are small gaps left behind the girders mounted in walls?
sq.urdu: دیواروں میں لگے گارڈرز کے پیچھے چھوٹے خلا کیوں چھوڑے جاتے ہیں؟
sq.pashto: په دېوالونو کې د ګارډرونو شاته وړه تشه ولې پرېښودل کېږي؟
sq.ans: Girders expand on hot days; the gaps give room for thermal expansion so the girders do not push and crack the walls.
sq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

sq.q: Why you should not put a closed glass jar into a campfire? What could happen if you tossed an empty glass jar, with the lid on tight, into a fire?
sq.urdu: بند شیشے کا مرتبان کیمپ فائر میں کیوں نہیں ڈالنا چاہیے؟ اگر خالی مرتبان سخت بند ڈھکن کے ساتھ آگ میں پھینکیں تو کیا ہو سکتا ہے؟
sq.pashto: تړلی ښیښه ییز ګیلاس ولې په اور کې ونه اچوو؟ که خالي ګیلاس په ټینګ سرپوښ اور ته واچوو څه کېدای شي؟
sq.ans: The trapped air expands greatly when heated (gases expand far more than solids), building up pressure; glass also expands unevenly, so the jar can crack or explode.
sq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

sq.q: Explain why it is advisable to add water to an overheated automobile engine only slowly, and only with the engine running?
sq.urdu: وضاحت کریں کہ زیادہ گرم انجن میں پانی آہستہ اور انجن چلتے ہوئے ہی کیوں ڈالنا چاہیے؟
sq.pashto: تشریح کړئ چې ولې ډېر تود انجن ته اوبه ورو او یوازې د چلېدونکي انجن پر مهال اچول کېږي؟
sq.ans: Cold water on hot metal causes sudden, uneven contraction that can crack the engine block; adding it slowly with the engine running circulates the water so the temperature falls gradually and evenly.
sq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

sq.q: Explain why burns caused by steam at 100 °C on the skin are often more severe than burns caused by water at 100 °C?
sq.urdu: وضاحت کریں کہ 100 °C کی بھاپ سے جلنا 100 °C کے پانی سے جلنے سے زیادہ شدید کیوں ہوتا ہے؟
sq.pashto: تشریح کړئ چې د 100 °C بخار سوځېدنه د 100 °C اوبو تر سوځېدنې ولې سخته وي؟
sq.ans: Steam condensing on the skin releases its large latent heat of vaporization (2.26 × 10⁶ J/kg) in addition to the heat given out while cooling, so it delivers much more energy than water at the same temperature (p.222).
sq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

sq.q: Explain why cities like Karachi situated by the ocean tend to have less extreme temperatures than inland cities at the same latitude?
sq.urdu: وضاحت کریں کہ کراچی جیسے ساحلی شہروں کا درجۂ حرارت اسی عرض بلد کے اندرونی شہروں سے کم شدید کیوں ہوتا ہے؟
sq.pashto: تشریح کړئ چې د کراچۍ په څېر ساحلي ښارونه د هماغه عرض البلد د داخلي ښارونو په پرتله ولې لږ سخته تودوخه لري؟
sq.ans: Water has a very high specific heat (4190 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹), so the sea warms and cools slowly; sea and land breezes carry this moderating effect to coastal cities (p.217).
sq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

sq.q: An iron rim which is fixed around a wooden wheel is heated before its fixture. Explain why?
sq.urdu: لکڑی کے پہیے پر لوہے کا چھلا لگانے سے پہلے اسے گرم کیوں کیا جاتا ہے؟
sq.pashto: د لرګین څرخ شاوخوا د اوسپنې کړۍ له لګولو مخکې ولې تودول کېږي؟
sq.ans: At room temperature the rim is slightly smaller than the wheel; heating expands it so it slips on, and on cooling it contracts to give a very tight fit (p.215).
sq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

sq.q: Why is ice at 0 °C a better coolant of soft drinks than water at 0 °C?
sq.urdu: 0 °C کی برف 0 °C کے پانی سے بہتر ٹھنڈک کیوں پہنچاتی ہے؟
sq.pashto: ولې 0 °C یخ د 0 °C اوبو په پرتله د مشروباتو ښه سړوونکی دی؟
sq.ans: Melting ice absorbs its latent heat of fusion (3.33 × 10⁵ J/kg) from the drink without rising in temperature, so it removes far more heat than water at 0 °C.
sq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

sq.q: Why we feel cool after perspiration?
sq.urdu: پسینے کے بعد ہمیں ٹھنڈک کیوں محسوس ہوتی ہے؟
sq.pashto: له خولې وروسته ولې د سړښت احساس کوو؟
sq.ans: Sweat evaporates, and the escaping high-energy molecules take latent heat from the skin; evaporation causes cooling (p.226).
sq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: Explain the terms internal energy and temperature. Use kinetic theory to distinguish between heat internal energy and temperature.
lq.urdu: اندرونی توانائی اور درجۂ حرارت کی وضاحت کریں۔ حرکی نظریے سے حرارت، اندرونی توانائی اور درجۂ حرارت میں فرق کریں۔
lq.pashto: داخلي انرژي او د تودوخې درجه تشریح کړئ. د حرکي تیورۍ په مرسته د تودوخې، داخلي انرژۍ او د تودوخې درجې توپیر وکړئ.
lq.ans: Internal energy is the sum of kinetic and potential energies of all the atoms of a body; temperature (in kelvin) measures the average kinetic energy of the molecules; heat is energy transferred from a hotter to a colder body because of a temperature difference. Two equal hot iron ingots have the same temperature but twice the internal energy of one (p.198-200).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: How do we measure temperature? Explain liquid in glass thermometer.
lq.urdu: ہم درجۂ حرارت کیسے ناپتے ہیں؟ شیشے میں مائع والے تھرمامیٹر کی وضاحت کریں۔
lq.pashto: تودوخه څنګه اندازه کوو؟ په ښیښه کې د مایع ترمامیټر تشریح کړئ.
lq.ans: With a thermometer that uses a thermometric property (e.g. thermal expansion). In a liquid-in-glass thermometer, liquid (mercury or alcohol) in a sealed bulb expands up a capillary when heated and is read on a scale on the stem; the liquid must be visible, expand uniformly and a lot, and not stick to the glass (p.201-202).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: What are various temperature scales? Derive mathematical expressions for the conversion of various scales of temperature.
lq.urdu: درجۂ حرارت کے مختلف پیمانے کون سے ہیں؟ ان کی باہمی تبدیلی کی ریاضیاتی مساواتیں اخذ کریں۔
lq.pashto: د تودوخې بېلابېلې پیمانې کومې دي؟ د اړولو ریاضي اړیکې ترلاسه کړئ.
lq.ans: Celsius (ice 0 °C, steam 100 °C, 100 divisions), Fahrenheit (32 °F, 212 °F, 180 divisions), Kelvin (273 K, 373 K, 100 divisions). From (T₁ − ice)/N₁ = (T₂ − ice)/N₂: T°C = 5/9 (T°F − 32), T°F = 9/5 T°C + 32, T°C = T_K − 273, T_K = T°C + 273 (p.202-204).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: What is meant by linear thermal expansion and volume thermal expansion of solids?
lq.urdu: ٹھوس اجسام کے طولی اور حجمی حرارتی پھیلاؤ سے کیا مراد ہے؟
lq.pashto: د جامدو اوږدیز او حجمي تودوخیز پراخوالی څه دی؟
lq.ans: Linear: increase in length with temperature, Δl = α l₀ ΔT, l_T = l₀(1 + αΔT). Volume: increase in volume, ΔV = γ V₀ ΔT, V_T = V₀(1 + γΔT); for solids γ = 3α (p.205-209).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: What is thermal expansion of liquids? Why we have real and apparent thermal expansion in liquids? Illustrate with the help an experiment.
lq.urdu: مائعات کا حرارتی پھیلاؤ کیا ہے؟ مائعات میں حقیقی اور ظاہری پھیلاؤ کیوں ہوتا ہے؟ تجربے سے واضح کریں۔
lq.pashto: د مایعاتو تودوخیز پراخوالی څه دی؟ ولې په مایعاتو کې حقیقي او ښکاره پراخوالی لرو؟ په تجربه یې روښانه کړئ.
lq.ans: Liquids only have volume expansion. Heating affects both liquid and container, so the observed (apparent) expansion is less than the real one: V_A = V_R − V_C. In a flask, the level first falls from A to B (vessel expands), then rises to C; BC = real expansion, AC = apparent, AB = vessel expansion; BC = AC + AB (p.211-212).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: Define heat capacity and specific heat capacity of a substance. Explain the importance of high specific heat capacity of water.
lq.urdu: کسی مادے کی حرارتی گنجائش اور مخصوص حرارتی گنجائش کی تعریف کریں اور پانی کی بلند مخصوص حرارتی گنجائش کی اہمیت بیان کریں۔
lq.pashto: د یوې مادې تودوخیز ظرفیت او ځانګړی تودوخیز ظرفیت تعریف کړئ او د اوبو د لوړ ځانګړي تودوخیز ظرفیت اهمیت بیان کړئ.
lq.ans: Heat capacity c_m = ΔQ/ΔT (J K⁻¹); specific heat c = ΔQ/(m ΔT) (J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹). Water (4190 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹) keeps coastal climates moderate, drives land and sea breezes and the monsoon, and is an effective coolant in car radiators (p.216-217).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: What is meant by the latent heat of fusion and latent heat of vaporization of a substance?
lq.urdu: کسی مادے کی پگھلاؤ کی مخفی حرارت اور بخارات بننے کی مخفی حرارت سے کیا مراد ہے؟
lq.pashto: د یوې مادې د ویلې کېدو پټه تودوخه او د بخار کېدو پټه تودوخه څه ده؟
lq.ans: Latent heat of fusion: heat needed to change a given mass from solid to liquid without change of temperature, ΔQ = m L_f (water 3.33 × 10⁵ J/kg). Latent heat of vaporization: heat needed to change liquid to gas without change of temperature, ΔQ = m L_v (water 2.26 × 10⁶ J/kg). Both in J kg⁻¹; the heating curve shows flat parts at 0 °C and 100 °C (p.219-222).
lq.answerOrigin: SpaceBook answer (no answer is printed in the textbook)

lq.q: What is meant by evaporation? On what factors the evaporation of a liquid depends? Explain how cooling is produced by evaporation. Differentiate between boiling and evaporation.
lq.urdu: تبخیر سے کیا مراد ہے؟ مائع کی تبخیر کن عوامل پر منحصر ہے؟ تبخیر سے ٹھنڈک کیسے پیدا ہوتی ہے؟ ابلنے اور تبخیر میں فرق کریں۔
lq.pashto: تبخیر څه ده؟ د مایع تبخیر په کومو عواملو پورې اړه لري؟ تبخیر څنګه یخوالی رامنځته کوي؟ د ایشېدو او تبخیر توپیر وکړئ.
lq.ans: Evaporation: slow change of a liquid into vapour at any temperature below its boiling point. Factors: nature of liquid, temperature of liquid and surroundings, water vapour in air, surface area, air movement, dryness and air pressure. Cooling: the fastest molecules escape, lowering the average kinetic energy of those left. Evaporation occurs at the surface below the boiling point; boiling occurs at the boiling point throughout the liquid (p.224-226).
